spanish: No andarás chismoso en tus pueblos; no te pararás sobre sangre de tu prójimo; yo Jehová.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect עמד is simple intransitive stand; the reflexive clitic te has no pronoun or reflexive stem in the token and can be read as stop-yourself.

notes: Plural pueblos, construct sangre de tu prójimo, and verbless yo Jehová match the tokens.
